title: Dana I Beta 11 stuck in pairing Loop
body:
Changing phone to Pixel, 
Restore my settings from preferences.
Started to pair pump and I entered the wrong PIN.

Now it is stuck in a loop.

I have cleared the Bluetooth stacks.

restarted phone.

The pump can be paired to Anydana.  Which I have now removed but it cannot pair to AAPS.  See video

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/37948551/148898789-3f8217d5-5167-4775-8ef5-34fdc80ef0ea.mp4

.

comments.body:
make sure you removed pump from paired devices in android
long click on BT icon on Dana tab can reset pairing info inside AAPS

I did all that didn't work. So I had to revert to the troublesome Samsung. Next time I will factory reset the pixel

Sent from my mobile.
